## Claims
- [source-backed] \(\Lambda/I_{r,n-r}\) has the Schur basis indexed by partitions in the \(r\times(n-r)\) box. [source-2, lines 1318-1324]
- [proved] Conditional on the stipulated box/Schur/Pieri presentation, \(i,j\ge2\), \(q=i+p\), \(r=j+c\), and \(\min(p,c)=1\), the degree enumeration is
  \[
  J_d=\mathbb Zx_0,\quad J_{d+1}=\mathbb Z\{x_1,y_1\},\quad
  J_{d+2}=\mathbb Z\{\gamma,x_2,z,y_2,\theta\},
  \]
  omitting \(\gamma\) for \(p=1\) and \(\theta\) for \(c=1\). Moreover
  \[
  A_1=\langle h_1\rangle,\quad A_2=\langle h_2,h_1^2\rangle,\quad
  A_3=\langle h_3,h_2h_1,h_1^3\rangle,
  \]
  and, writing \(r_2=h_2x_1,r_3=h_2y_1,r_4=h_1\gamma,r_5=h_1x_2,r_6=h_1z,r_7=h_1y_2,r_8=h_1\theta\),
  \[
  h_2h_1x_0=r_2+r_3,\quad
  h_1^3x_0=r_4+r_5+2r_6+r_7+r_8,
  \]
  \[
  h_1^2x_1=r_4+r_5+r_6,\qquad
  h_1^2y_1=r_6+r_7+r_8.
  \]
- [unsupported] The supplied material does not define “the fifteen cases in (4),” their column orders, or their intended \(R_{\mathrm{full}}\); therefore fifteen literal products \(\mathcal C R_{\mathrm{selected}}=R_{\mathrm{full}}\) cannot be specified without inventing data.

## Strategy
The degree enumeration follows by listing partitions containing \(i^j\) with \(0,1,2\) added boxes. The four identities follow from
\[
h_1x_0=x_1+y_1,\quad h_1x_1=\gamma+x_2+z,\quad
h_1y_1=z+y_2+\theta,
\]
and multiplication by \(h_2\) or \(h_1\).

For \(A_2,A_3\), the changes to the Schur bases are triangular:
\[
h_2h_1=s_{(3)}+s_{(2,1)},\qquad
h_1^3=s_{(3)}+2s_{(2,1)}+s_{(1,1,1)},
\]
with determinant \(1\).
